handoff.salientSummary: Fixed all five round-2 foh-core findings in commit 521df7ed. Occasion now returns the bare code, contact-status labels use the canonical values with Arabic, book route defaults follow the location time zone, setup conflicts is a true dry run, and expired hold occupancies no longer consume capacity. Each item has a test. tenant-api (1599), @repo/reservations (74) and the touched App tests pass, and typecheck and Lingui check pass. Curl and browser checks confirmed the behaviour live.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: (1) rsv-day-feed-service.ts serializeReservationsForBook looks up the occasion tag system key and returns the bare code in `occasion` (falling back to the tag id minus a `tag_occ_` prefix), keeping `occasionTagId` for the id; the App's stripTagPrefix workaround in book-api.ts is removed. (2) CONTACT_STATUS_LABELS and the detail-sheet CONTACT_STATUSES are rekeyed to none/left_message/no_answer/wrong_number (not_contacted also labelled), the selector normalizes not_contacted to none, lingui extract was run, Arabic msgstr filled for Left Message, No Answer and Wrong Number, and check-lingui passes. (3) New services/rsv-business-date.ts (getLocationBusinessDate, resolveBusinessDate) uses currentBusinessDate with the location time zone and dayStartMin; all nine UTC-date defaults in operator-reservations-book.ts now use it (not only the three cited lines). (4) reflowFutureBookingsForLocation gets a `dryRun` option that works on an in-memory occupancy mirror and skips reservation updates, occupancy writes, day-version bumps and auto_reassigned event writes; detectLocationConflicts uses it. (5) availability.ts filters `occupancies` rows of kind hold with expiresAt <= now.

discoveredIssues.description: RSV_TAG_SYSTEM_KEY_VALUES in packages/tenant-db/src/schema.ts lists only first_visit and frequent_no_show, but the seed script and the new occasion lookup store system keys such as 'anniversary' and 'birthday'. Drizzle does not check the enum at runtime, so it works, but the type is inaccurate and the new test casts with `as never`.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Add 'birthday' and 'anniversary' to RSV_TAG_SYSTEM_KEY_VALUES in a follow-up and drop the cast.
